name: nova-extension
description: Nova browser extension: save a page to Nova, or study it, when you ask.

scripts.build:safari: node scripts/build.mjs && xcodebuild -project safari/Nova/Nova.xcodeproj -scheme Nova -configuration Debug build
scripts.build:safari:release: NOVA_RELEASE=1 node scripts/build.mjs && xcodebuild -project safari/Nova/Nova.xcodeproj -scheme Nova -configuration Debug build
